{{Quote|SD-357, have you found anyone in the south passage?|[[LD-112]]|<ref name="Revival" />}}
'''SD-357''' was a police [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that was active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and served at a large [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. It was destroyed by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] when he and his brother [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] [[Raid on the Cybloc Transfer Station/Legends|raided]] the station and eliminated all the droids that faced them.

==Biography==
Shortly after his resurrection, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and his brother, [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] traveled to the station where SD-357 was guarding. Upon their arrival, a sudden power outage sent all the security droids to the upper levels near the control room. SD-357 was sent to investigate the South passage, where he met Maul and was swiftly destroyed by him, his fellow officers soon following.
